provenance.dataset: NASA C-MAPSS turbofan degradation, FD001 test set
provenance.note: This is real benchmark telemetry, not invented data. It is engine unit 53 of the FD001 test set, truncated by the benchmark authors 26 cycles before failure. It is used here so the fitted RUL path runs on data the model was actually validated against, and so the demo has a prediction with a known right answer.
